reports.title: EZCORP Reports Fourth Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results

desk.headline: Revenue up 33% to $447.1m, above estimates; EPS $0.43 in line; no numerical guidance for fiscal 2027
results: Revenue rose 33% to $447.1m and gross profit 29% to $255.8m; without the SMG acquisition, revenue grew 20%.
Diluted EPS rose 26% to $0.43 (adjusted EPS also $0.43); full-year EPS rose 46% to $2.07 on record revenue of $1.69bn.
Pawn loans grew 31% to $402.8m; same-store loans rose 13% in the US and 25% in Latin America.
Scrap gold sales jumped 86%, but scrap margins fell to 19% from 29% as gold slipped from Q3 levels.
The store count reached 1,590 in 15 countries; cash fell to $295.1m after repaying SMG's $134.2m of debt and paying for acquisitions.

guidance.summary: EZCORP gives no numerical guidance. On the call, management described fiscal 2027 mainly as a year of integrating SMG, with higher interest and labour costs.

points: The CEO called loan demand exceptionally strong, linked to cost-of-living pressure on customers.
Scrap margins are expected to settle at about 15% if gold stays near current levels.
SMG integration is on track but slower than first expected; it adds a full 12 months in fiscal 2027.
Fiscal 2027 is mainly an integration year, with faster new-store openings possible from 2028.
Higher net interest cost, Latin American wage increases and a new point-of-sale system will weigh on costs.
call.source: EZCORP (EZPW) Q4 2026 Earnings Call Transcript — The Motley Fool, 12 Nov 2026

watch: Progress on SMG integration and its profit contribution.
Scrap margins and the effect of gold prices.
Loan growth and redemptions through the December season.
